name: hotseat
description: Answer Claude's questions out loud on a voice call, on ElevenLabs, OpenAI Realtime or fully local (Kokoro + Whisper).

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Runs the call on an ElevenLabs voice agent, created in your account on the first call. Leave empty to use the local voice (Kokoro + Whisper in your browser).

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Runs the call on OpenAI Realtime (gpt-realtime). Used when Voice engine is openai, or when no ElevenLabs key is set.

voice_engine.title: Voice engine
voice_engine.description: elevenlabs, openai or local. Empty: ElevenLabs when its key is set, else OpenAI when its key is set, otherwise local.

kokoro_voice.title: Local voice
kokoro_voice.description: Kokoro voice for the local engine, such as af_heart, am_michael or bf_emma. Empty: af_heart.
